create_mistral_loader: create a MistralLoader instance to process a PDF file through the Mistral OCR API
run_loader_sync: run the MistralLoader.load() method to synchronously upload, OCR, and extract text from a PDF file
run_loader_async: run the MistralLoader.load_async() method to asynchronously upload, OCR, and extract text from a PDF file
run_batch_processing: run the MistralLoader.load_multiple_async() static method to concurrently process multiple PDF files with controlled concurrency
review_mistral_loader: review the MistralLoader class and its sync/async OCR workflow with retry logic and connection pooling
